source.source_text: Purpose: bounded filename/path discovery within explicit authorized roots. Input: roots:string[], query:string, max_results?:1..1000. Output: canonical matching paths and safe metadata. Contract: L1 read_only; scope mac.files.search; target filesystem_roots; timeout 20000ms; cap 512KiB; network none; filesystem read_allowed_roots; secret paths may be hidden/existence-only and content never returned; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
